# moonshotai chat-template text

`tool_declaration_ts.tsx` is a port to TSX of `tool_declaration_ts.py` from the Kimi K2.5, K2.6
and K2.7 model repositories (the same file in each): the code that writes a model's tools as
TypeScript-style declarations before the chat template runs. It is Moonshot AI's work under each
model's license, as the templates below are.

<!-- converted templates: generated by tools/adopt_templates.py -->

`tools/jinja2tsx.py`. Its text is the template's own.
